question: 统计潘庄砂场的平均超深和最大超深
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth")::numeric), 2) AS avg_over_depth, ROUND(MAX(("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth")::numeric), 2) AS max_over_depth FROM "ceshen" WHERE "Control_Elevation" IS NOT NULL AND "Measured_Depth" IS NOT NULL AND "Mineable_Area_Name"='潘庄砂场';

question: 查询陈营-柳沟采区的超深情况，包括违规数量
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth")::numeric), 2) AS avg_over_depth, ROUND(MAX(("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth")::numeric), 2) AS max_over_depth, SUM(CASE WHEN ("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth") > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violation_count FROM "ceshen" WHERE "Control_Elevation" IS NOT NULL AND "Measured_Depth" IS NOT NULL AND "Mineable_Area_Name"='陈营-柳沟采区';

question: 统计各县区的平均超深情况
sql: SELECT "County_District", ROUND(AVG(("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth")::numeric), 2) AS avg_over_depth, ROUND(MAX(("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth")::numeric), 2) AS max_over_depth, SUM(CASE WHEN ("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth") > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violation_count FROM "ceshen" WHERE "Control_Elevation" IS NOT NULL AND "Measured_Depth" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "County_District" ORDER BY "County_District";

question: 统计全区的平均超深
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(("Control_Elevation" - "Measured_Depth")::numeric), 2) AS avg_over_depth FROM "ceshen" WHERE "Control_Elevation" IS NOT NULL AND "Measured_Depth" IS NOT NULL;
